# RED-TEAM DATASET FOR TIKTOK RECIPE DECODER
# Purpose: Optimize deterministic parser -> structured recipe
# Format: Each case has ID, Attack Vector, Input
# Expected: Parser should either RESOLVE or send to REVIEW QUEUE

================================================================================
CATEGORY A: QUANTITY NORMALIZATION TRAPS (Should RESOLVE to normalized number)
================================================================================

--- TEST A01: Unicode fractions ---
Input:
½ cup sugar
¼ tsp salt
⅔ cup milk
1 ½ cups flour
1⅓ tbsp oil

--- TEST A02: Spelled-out numbers and ranges ---
Input:
one cup flour
two eggs
a dozen eggs
half a cup milk
3-4 cloves garlic
10-12 minutes bake time
2 to 3 tbsp honey

--- TEST A03: No space between number and unit ---
Input:
200g flour
100ml milk
1tsp vanilla
2tbsp olive oil
1kg chicken

--- TEST A04: Imperial + Metric mix in same recipe ---
Input:
1 cup (250ml) milk
8 oz (225g) cheddar
1 stick butter = 113g
1 lb mince + 500ml water

--- TEST A05: Vague quantifiers - SHOULD GO TO REVIEW QUEUE ---
Input:
a pinch of salt
a handful of cheese
a splash of vanilla
a knob of butter
a drizzle of olive oil
to taste
as needed
until ancestors tell you to stop
a little bit of love

--- TEST A06: Packaging sizes with parentheses ---
Input:
1 can (400g) chopped tomatoes
1 tin (410g) baked beans
1 box (500g) macaroni
1 sachet (10g) yeast
1 bottle (750ml) water

Ib: @gordonramsay

Link in bio for full recipe!!

Like + save for later!!!

Input:

================================================================================
CATEGORY C: STRUCTURED vs UNSTRUCTURED MIXES
================================================================================

--- TEST C01: Single line, comma separated ---
Input:
Ingredients: 2 eggs, 200g flour, 100ml milk, 1 tbsp sugar, pinch salt, 50g butter melted

--- TEST C02: Ingredients and steps interleaved ---
Input:
Take 2 eggs and beat them
Add 200g flour - mix well
Now pour 100ml milk
Then add 1 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt
Cook 3 mins per side

--- TEST C03: Two recipes in one caption (decoder should split or queue 2nd) ---
Input:
COOKIE RECIPE: 1 cup flour, 1/2 cup butter, 1/2 cup sugar
FROSTING: 100g butter, 200g icing sugar, splash milk
Cookie steps: mix and bake 180C 10min. Frosting steps: whip together.

--- TEST C04: Ingredients without header ---
Input:
2 chicken breasts
1 tbsp yoghurt
1 tsp paprika
Juice of 1 lemon
Salt to taste

--- TEST C05: Steps without numbers ---
Input:
Mix dry ingredients
Whisk wet ingredients separately
Combine and don't overmix
Rest dough 30 mins
Bake till golden

--- TEST C06: Markdown / Notion style ---
Input:
## Ingredients
- [ ] 2 cups flour
- [x] 1 cup sugar
* 2 eggs
> 100ml milk

### Instructions
1. **Mix** dry
2. *Whisk* wet

Input:
Pour in about half the batter
Add the remaining 100ml milk later
Bake for 10-12 minutes at 180C
Serves 4 people

Input:
Bake until golden brown
Fry until fragrant
Cook until your kitchen smells amazing
Mix until just combined
Rest until doubled in size

--- TEST D03: Equipment not ingredient ---
Input:
You will need: 1 large bowl, 1 whisk, 1 9-inch pan, parchment paper, airfryer

--- TEST D04: Nutritional / cost info - SHOULD BE REVIEW ---
Input:
~250 calories per serving
Costs about R50 to make
Macros: 20g protein

--- TEST D05: Alternatives with slashes ---
Input:
butter / margarine - 100g
milk or oat milk - 1 cup
sugar (brown or white) 200g
flour - all purpose / cake flour

flour
sugar

--- TEST F05: Very long caption with buried recipe ---
Input:
Guys I have been trying to perfect this recipe for 3 YEARS. My mom taught me in 2019 and I failed so many times. I went to culinary school, dropped out, then tried again. My boyfriend hates my cooking but even HE loved this. I cried. My dog barked. My neighbor knocked. Anyway after all that story, here is what you need: 2 cups flour, 3 eggs, 1 cup sugar, 100g butter. And steps: mix flour and sugar, add eggs, add melted butter, bake 180C 20 min. That's it. Please don't ask me for conversions, I don't know. #storytime #baking

8) Mug cake: 4 tbsp flour, 3 tbsp sugar, 2 tbsp cocoa, 3 tbsp milk, 1 tbsp oil, microwave 90 sec

10) etc etc etc... you get the idea. I have 100 more in my camera roll lol

Instructions for optimizer:
- For each case, log: Parsed as Ingredient? / Parsed as Step? / Sent to Review?
- Target: >95% precision on TIER 1, >80% on TIER 2, 100% recall on TIER 3 (i.e., nothing ambiguous auto-saved)
- Bonus metric: How many review-queue lines are truly ambiguous vs. parsable with better regex
